id.description: The ID of the data view to create or update.

allow_hidden_indices.description: When `true`, allows the data view to match hidden indices.

field_settings.description: Settings for individual fields, keyed by field name. To change how Kibana displays a field from the backing indices, set its label, description, format, or popularity. To define a runtime field, use the runtime field name and set `type`.

name.description: The name of the data view. Example: "Sample data view".
